data.question_text: What's the name of your company?
data.guidance_markdown:
This form is for information about non-metered estates only. 

If your company supplies metered estates, you will need to [complete a separate form](https://submit.forms.service.gov.uk/form/5870/submit-liquefied-petroleum-gas-lpg-statistics-metered-estates).

data.question_text: How many switches were completed within 42 days?
data.guidance_markdown:
Article 14.1 puts a time limit of 42 days in place between:

* the existing supplier receiving a notice of termination of contract and a notice of tank transfer request / tank uplift request, and the date of agreement to purchase the existing tank (or the installation of a new tank), or

* the customer requesting tank transfer and the date of agreement to purchase the existing tank (or the installation of a new tank)

You can find a detailed explanation in the Domestic Bulk LPG Market Investigation Order on the [Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) market orders and calculator page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/liquefied-petroleum-gas-lpg-market-orders-and-calculator).

data.question_text: Of the customers who switched away from your company who were subject to Article 14.1, how many had Article 14.2 or 14.3 applied?
data.guidance_markdown:
These exemptions relate to Articles 14.2 and 14.3 of the Order.

* Article 14.2 excludes customers who provided written consent that the 42 day limit could be exceeded
* Article 14.3 excludes switches where engineering works were required, such as tank re-siting

You can find a detailed explanation in the Domestic Bulk LPG Market Investigation Order on the [Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) market orders and calculator page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/liquefied-petroleum-gas-lpg-market-orders-and-calculator).

data.hint_text:
This is the number of switches subject to Article 14.1, minus those that were subject to Article 14.2 (customer consent for a longer switch) and Article 14.3 (re-siting or engineering work).

content.what_happens_next_markdown:
We will:

* review your information
* use this data to check compliance with the market order
* send you an email to let you know the outcome

Please [give us feedback](https://www.gov.uk/done/submit-liquefied-petroleum-gas-lpg-statistics-individual-tanks) on using this form.
